title: Marketplace Security Packet — Evidence Index (AWS/GCP Marketplace Reviews)
author: Olga Petrov
body:
## Purpose
This page is the **source-of-truth index** for security/compliance evidence used in **AWS Marketplace** and **GCP Cloud Marketplace** listing reviews and in enterprise buyer security questionnaires triggered by marketplace procurement.

It answers:
- What evidence exists and where it lives (source of truth)
- What we are allowed to share (public vs under NDA vs internal-only)
- Who owns each artifact and how often it must be refreshed
- The request and approval workflow for Partnerships/PMM/Sales/SE

> IMPORTANT: This page is **restricted**. Do not copy/paste or forward evidence externally. Use the process below to provide links via approved secure channels.

---

## Evidence storage locations (approved)
All evidence is stored in the **Security Evidence Vault** (restricted shared drive) with role-based access.

Approved sharing mechanisms:
- **Secure link** from the Vault (time-bound when possible)
- Partner portal upload (AWS/GCP) performed only by approved submitters (see vendor-management page)
- If an email must be used for partner review, include only **public artifacts** or a link to the Vault; never attach restricted PDFs directly.

Not approved:
- Attaching SOC 2 reports to email threads
- Uploading evidence to personal drives or unapproved file sharing

---

## Shareability tiers (use consistently)
- **Public**: Can be linked from marketplace listing or docs site.
- **Partner-review (NDA)**: May be shared with AWS/GCP reviewers or prospective customers **only under NDA** and only via approved secure link.
- **Customer-only (NDA + need-to-know)**: For active procurement/security review; do not provide to partners unless explicitly requested and approved by GRC + Security.
- **Internal-only**: Never shared externally.

Default rule: If unsure, treat as **internal-only** until Olga Petrov (GRC) confirms shareability.

---

## Evidence index (marketplace-focused)
The table below lists the artifacts most commonly requested for AWS/GCP marketplace reviews and enterprise procurement.

### A) Compliance attestations & audit reports
1) SOC 2 Type II Report (latest)
- Purpose: Primary assurance report for buyers; sometimes requested in marketplace review.
- Shareability: Customer-only (NDA + need-to-know)
- Owner: Olga Petrov (GRC)
- Refresh cadence: Annual (upon new audit cycle)
- Source of truth: Security Evidence Vault → /Compliance/SOC2/
- Notes: Provide via secure link only. Do not quote report language in listings.

2) SOC 2 Bridge Letter (if audit period gap exists)
- Purpose: Covers period between SOC 2 report end date and current date.
- Shareability: Customer-only (NDA + need-to-know)
- Owner: Olga Petrov (GRC)
- Refresh cadence: As needed; typically quarterly while in gap
- Source of truth: Vault → /Compliance/SOC2/
- Notes: Only share when required to address timing gaps.

3) ISO 27001 Certificate + Statement of Applicability (if applicable)
- Purpose: Additional assurance; some enterprise buyers require.
- Shareability: Certificate may be Partner-review (NDA) or Public depending on final Legal guidance; SoA is typically Customer-only (NDA).
- Owner: Olga Petrov (GRC)
- Refresh cadence: Annual surveillance / recert cycle
- Source of truth: Vault → /Compliance/ISO27001/
- Notes: Confirm current shareability before use.

4) Subprocessor list (current)
- Purpose: Marketplace buyers ask for data handling vendors.
- Shareability: Public (preferred) or Partner-review (NDA) if details require
- Owner: Naomi Feldman (PM, security/compliance requirements) + Legal liaison
- Refresh cadence: Monthly review; publish updates as changes occur
- Source of truth: Vault → /Legal-Privacy/Subprocessors/ and docs site canonical page
- Notes: Use the docs site link whenever possible.


### B) Security testing & vulnerability management
5) Penetration Test Executive Summary (latest)
- Purpose: Common requirement for enterprise procurement and sometimes marketplace validation.
- Shareability: Customer-only (NDA + need-to-know)
- Owner: Marcus Lin (Security Eng)
- Refresh cadence: Annual (or after major architectural change)
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Testing/PenTest/
- Notes: Provide the executive summary and remediation attestation; do not provide raw findings unless explicitly approved.

6) Penetration Test Remediation Letter / Attestation
- Purpose: Confirms closure of critical/high findings.
- Shareability: Customer-only (NDA + need-to-know)
- Owner: Marcus Lin
- Refresh cadence: Per test cycle
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Testing/PenTest/
- Notes: Include dates and scope; avoid “all vulnerabilities eliminated” wording.

7) Quarterly Vulnerability Scan Attestation (internal summary)
- Purpose: Demonstrates ongoing vuln management program.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA) or Customer-only (NDA) depending on content
- Owner: Marcus Lin
- Refresh cadence: Quarterly
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Testing/Vuln-Scans/
- Notes: Share the attestation letter (not tool exports) unless requested and approved.

8) Vulnerability Disclosure Policy (VDP) / Security contact
- Purpose: Often requested by marketplaces as a policy link.
- Shareability: Public
- Owner: Marcus Lin + Legal
- Refresh cadence: Annual review
- Source of truth: Public policy page + Vault copy
- Notes: Ensure security@ contact and response expectations are correct.


### C) Architecture, encryption, and data handling
9) System Architecture Overview (marketplace version)
- Purpose: High-level diagram for reviewers; clarifies control plane vs data plane.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA)
- Owner: Marcus Lin (accuracy) + Elliot Price (Docs workflow)
- Refresh cadence: Semi-annual or upon major change
- Source of truth: Vault → /Architecture/Marketplace-Packet/
- Notes: Use the “marketplace-redacted” version (no internal hostnames/account IDs).

10) Encryption in Transit Statement + Diagram
- Purpose: Required to support listing claims (TLS versions, endpoints).
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA) (some text may be Public in FAQ)
- Owner: Marcus Lin
- Refresh cadence: Semi-annual review; immediate update on crypto policy changes
- Source of truth: Vault → /Architecture/Encryption/
- Notes: Keep language consistent with Marketplace Security FAQ.

11) Encryption at Rest Statement + Diagram (incl. KMS)
- Purpose: Marketplace review often asks “how is customer data encrypted” and “who manages keys”.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA)
- Owner: Marcus Lin
- Refresh cadence: Semi-annual review
- Source of truth: Vault → /Architecture/Encryption/
- Notes: Do not over-promise on “customer-managed keys” unless Redwood Private deployment scope is explicitly described.

12) Data Retention & Deletion Policy (product behavior statement)
- Purpose: Enterprise procurement requirement; also used to answer marketplace questions.
- Shareability: Public summary + Customer-only (NDA) detailed version
- Owner: Naomi Feldman (PM) + Security review by Marcus Lin
- Refresh cadence: Quarterly review (and with product changes)
- Source of truth: Vault → /Privacy-Data/Data-Retention/ and docs site page
- Notes: Ensure Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private differences are explicit.

13) Data Residency / Region Handling Statement
- Purpose: Common marketplace buyer question (where data is processed/stored).
- Shareability: Public summary + Partner-review (NDA) expanded statement
- Owner: Mina Haddad (Regional routing) + Olga Petrov (GRC wording)
- Refresh cadence: Quarterly
- Source of truth: Vault → /Privacy-Data/Residency/ and Marketplace FAQ canonical copy
- Notes: Avoid absolute claims; specify “available regions” and “customer configuration”.


### D) Logging, access control, and operational controls
14) Audit Logging Overview (what we log; retention options)
- Purpose: Buyer requirement and marketplace review clarifier.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA) (public summary allowed)
- Owner: Marcus Lin (controls) + Rafael Mendes (SRE) for operational accuracy
- Refresh cadence: Quarterly
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Controls/Audit-Logging/
- Notes: Must align with product capabilities (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and add-on SKUs (retention).

15) Access Control & SSO/SAML Overview
- Purpose: Enterprise buyers ask about RBAC and SSO.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA) or Public summary
- Owner: Marcus Lin + Product owner (as applicable)
- Refresh cadence: Semi-annual
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Controls/Identity/
- Notes: Avoid implying SSO is available on all plans unless confirmed in packaging.

16) Incident Response (IR) Policy (summary) + Contact Process
- Purpose: Marketplace reviewers and procurement often request proof of IR program.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA) summary; full policy is internal-only unless approved
- Owner: Dr. Aisha Rahman (Security sponsor) + Marcus Lin
- Refresh cadence: Annual
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Controls/Incident-Response/
- Notes: Share only the approved summary.

17) Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) Summary
- Purpose: Shows resilience posture; requested in some enterprise reviews.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA)
- Owner: Rafael Mendes (SRE) + Olga Petrov (GRC)
- Refresh cadence: Annual (plus after tests)
- Source of truth: Vault → /Security-Controls/BCDR/
- Notes: Provide summary; do not disclose sensitive infrastructure detail.


### E) Marketplace-specific evidence & operational proofs
18) Marketplace Shared Responsibility Model (Redwood vs Customer)
- Purpose: Clarifies boundaries for Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
- Shareability: Public or Partner-review (NDA) depending on detail level
- Owner: Naomi Feldman + Soojin Lee (PMM) with Security approval
- Refresh cadence: Quarterly
- Source of truth: Vault → /Marketplace/Shared-Responsibility/
- Notes: Must match listing copy; avoid contractual commitments in marketing text.

19) Marketplace Provisioning Security Controls (webhook validation, audit trail)
- Purpose: Supports claims that marketplace purchase → entitlement is secure and auditable.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA)
- Owner: Ethan Park (Eng, entitlement mapping) + Marcus Lin (Security)
- Refresh cadence: Quarterly or with pipeline changes
- Source of truth: Vault → /Marketplace/Provisioning-Security/
- Notes: Keep consistent with current implementation (idempotency, retries, validation).

20) Vendor Account Access & Rotation Policy (AWS/GCP partner portals)
- Purpose: Demonstrates access governance to marketplace vendor accounts.
- Shareability: Partner-review (NDA) summary; internal-only full SOP unless approved
- Owner: Olga Petrov (process) + Security Operations
- Refresh cadence: Annual; access list review quarterly
- Source of truth: Confluence policy page + Vault export
- Notes: Refer partners to summary only; no internal account identifiers.

---

## Refresh cadence & quarterly checklist
This page and the marketplace packet must be reviewed **quarterly**, even if no changes are expected.

Quarterly checklist (GRC owner: Olga Petrov):
1) Confirm SOC 2 report period currency; determine if bridge letter is needed.
2) Confirm pen test status and remediation attestation currency.
3) Validate encryption and audit logging diagrams against current architecture.
4) Confirm data retention/residency statements align with product behavior and SKU packaging.
5) Confirm policy links are still live and correct for marketplace listing attachments.
6) Update “last refreshed” markers in the packet cover page and notify Partnerships/PMM.

---

## Request + approval process (internal)
Who typically requests: Partnerships, PMM, Sales/SE, Customer Success, and occasionally Finance/Legal.

### Step-by-step
1) Identify what you need
- Marketplace submission (AWS/GCP): specify which partner, submission date, and which fields/attachments require evidence.
- Customer/prospect: include company name, stage (security review/procurement), and whether NDA is executed.

2) Open a Security Evidence request
- Create a ticket in the internal queue: **GRC / Evidence Request** (preferred), OR ping #security-compliance with “EVIDENCE REQUEST” and link a ticket.

3) GRC triage (Olga Petrov)
- Confirms NDA status and shareability tier.
- Selects correct redacted versions.
- Assigns Security Eng verification if claims/diagrams are involved.

4) Security technical verification (if applicable)
- Marcus Lin (or delegate) confirms technical accuracy of encryption/logging/access-control statements.

5) Final sign-off
- For high-risk artifacts (SOC 2, pen test, IR/BCDR): approval by **Olga Petrov + Dr. Aisha Rahman**.

6) Delivery
- GRC provides an approved secure link (and any required instructions).
- Only approved marketplace submitters upload to AWS/GCP partner portals.

### SLA targets
- Standard requests: 2 business days
- Marketplace submission blockers: same-day triage; 1 business day turnaround when possible

---

## Redaction rules (must-follow)
Before sharing any diagram or screenshot externally:
- Remove internal service names that expose architecture unnecessarily (keep high-level labels)
- Remove account IDs, project IDs, hostnames, internal URLs
- Remove employee names, Slack channels, ticket IDs (unless explicitly needed)
- Ensure timestamps and regions are not misleading (align with current supported regions)

If an artifact is not already available in a “marketplace-redacted” version, request redaction support from Docs (Elliot Price) and Security (Marcus Lin).

---

## Change log (high level)
- 2026-01-19: Updated evidence list to include marketplace provisioning security controls and clarified shareability tiers; aligned residency/retention statements with current SKU packaging.
- 2025-07-02: Added quarterly vulnerability scan attestation and standardized redaction rules for diagrams/screenshots.
- 2024-10-08: Initial publication for AWS/GCP marketplace listing refresh project.
